public static partial class StatusExtensions
{
    public static string GetString(this global::Status value)
    {
        return value switch
        {
            global::Status.Ok => "good",
            global::Status.Error => "Error",
            _ => value.ToString()
        };
    }

    public static string GetString(this global::Status value, global::StatusFormat format = global::StatusFormat.Default)
    {
        if ((format & global::StatusFormat.Name) == global::StatusFormat.Name)
        {
            if (value == global::Status.Ok) return "good";
            if (value == global::Status.Error) return "Error";
        }

        if ((format & global::StatusFormat.Value) == global::StatusFormat.Value)
        {
            return ((int)value).ToString(global::System.Globalization.NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
        }

        return value.ToString();
    }

    public static bool TryGetUnderlyingValue(this global::Status value, out int underlyingValue)
    {
        switch (value)
        {
            case global::Status.Ok:
                underlyingValue = 0;
                return true;
            case global::Status.Error:
                underlyingValue = 1;
                return true;
        }
        underlyingValue = default;
        return false;
    }

    public static int GetUnderlyingValue(this global::Status value)
    {
        if (!TryGetUnderlyingValue(value, out int underlyingValue))
            throw new global::System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException($"Invalid value: {value}");

        return underlyingValue;
    }
